changes.newValue: Create src/utils/ieltsWritingBandCalculator.ts with 4 functions: roundDownToHalf, roundOverallBand, calculateTaskBand, calculateOverallBand. Implements exact IELTS rounding rules from PRD 4.1.3.

newValue.text: calculateTaskBand averages 4 criteria then rounds down
calculateOverallBand uses 1/3 + 2/3 weighting for full test
Voided tasks filtered out before calculation

changes.newValue: 1. Create file 2. roundDownToHalf: Math.floor(value*2)/2 3. roundOverallBand: remainder >=0.25 rounds up 4. calculateTaskBand: avg 4 criteria, apply roundDownToHalf 5. calculateOverallBand: weighted avg for full test 6. Handle voided tasks 7. JSDoc all functions
Per-task: round DOWN (6.25->6.0). Overall: round UP from >=0.25 (6.25->6.5). Task 1 uses TA field, Task 2 uses TR field. All tasks voided = returns 0.
